# UrboSuites — Premium Studio Apartments in Pashan, Pune

> UrboSuites operates thoughtfully curated, high-rise studio serviced residences at VJ IndiLife Building C, Pashan Sus Road, Pashan, Pune, Maharashtra 411021, India. Designed specifically for extended workations, business professionals, and leisure travelers seeking serene Sahyadri mountain views combined with urban convenience.

## Available Suites

### 1. Hillcrest — Suite 201
- **Floor**: 14th Floor (High-rise corner unit)
- **Size**: 500 sq ft open-plan studio
- **Nightly Rate**: From ₹3,499 / night (Direct booking)
- **Capacity**: Up to 4 guests (1 Super King bed + comfortable sofa seating)
- **Key Highlights**: East-facing morning sunlight, panoramic sunrise views over the Sahyadri hills, regular peacock spotting from private balcony, dedicated workation workstation with 100Mbps fibre Wi-Fi and ergonomic chair.
- **Entertainment & Tech**: 55-inch 4K Smart TV with OTT streaming, inverter air conditioning, silent power backup.
- **Kitchen & Bath**: Fully equipped bar kitchen with induction stove, microwave, refrigerator, electric kettle, tea & coffee provisions, marble rain shower bathroom.

### 2. Gulmohar — Suite 101
- **Floor**: 7th Floor
- **Size**: 220 sq ft studio
- **Nightly Rate**: From ₹2,399 / night (Direct booking)
- **Capacity**: Up to 4 guests (1 Super King bed with artistic floral wall mural + sofa-cum-bed)
- **Key Highlights**: Unblocked, edge-to-edge emerald mountain and forest views, private balcony.
- **Entertainment & Tech**: 40-inch Smart TV, 100Mbps fibre Wi-Fi, inverter AC.
- **Kitchen & Bath**: Full kitchenette for quick meals (induction, microwave, kettle, fridge), rain shower bathroom.

## Shared Building Amenities (VJ IndiLife Building C)
- **Fitness Center**: Fully equipped podium gym with treadmills, elliptical cross trainers, commercial bench press, multi-gym, free weights, and an open-air stretching deck.
- **Work & Dining**: 1st-floor resident cafeteria serving light meals and snacks, and quiet professional meeting rooms.
- **Laundry**: Dedicated basement laundromat with coin/token washers and dryers.
- **Rooftop Terrace**: Expansive 360-degree observation deck with shaded gazebos and sunset views over Pashan and Baner hills.
- **Parking & Security**: Free reserved covered parking, 24/7 security guards, gated entry, and CCTV surveillance.

## Travel Distances & Connectivity from Pashan
- **Baner (High Street & Commercial Hub)**: 10 minutes (approx. 4 km)
- **Hinjewadi IT Park (Phase 1 & Phase 2)**: 15–20 minutes via Mumbai-Pune Highway
- **Bavdhan & Kothrud**: 10–15 minutes
- **Pune Railway Station**: 30 minutes (approx. 14 km)
- **Pune International Airport (PNQ)**: 45 minutes (approx. 20 km)
- **Local Amenities**: Pashan market, grocery stores, organic fruit stalls, and cafes within 5 minutes walking distance.
